metadata.title: Rigidity of Immersed Gauss Curvature Shrinkers in Euclidean Space
metadata.abstract: For every $m\geq2$, we prove that any connected closed oriented smooth immersion $X:M^m\to\mathbb{R}^{m+1}$ satisfying \[ K=\left\langle X,\nu\right\rangle \] is an embedding onto the unit sphere. No convexity is assumed. At a point maximizing $|X|$, we find a strictly convex component of $\{K>0\}$. If this component does not coincide with $M$, its polar immersion bounds an unbounded convex set. A finite area lemma then extends the local surface area formula for the polar body to a global measure identity. Using the vanishing first moment of surface area measure, we show that the origin lies in the interior of the polar body, contradicting the existence of recession directions. Thus the hypersurface is strictly convex, and the classification of strictly convex shrinkers completes the proof.

analysis.progressType: 无凸性高斯曲率收缩子刚性
analysis.workSummary: 作者证明任何维数 m≥2 的连通闭定向光滑超曲面浸入，若满足 K=〈X,ν〉，则实际上嵌入为单位球，无需先验凸性。通过正曲率分支、极性浸入和面积测度一阶矩排除非全局凸性，最后应用严格凸收缩子分类。
analysis.breakthrough: 把高斯曲率收缩子球面刚性从凸类推广到任意闭定向光滑浸入。
analysis.limitations: 仍要求闭、连通、定向及精确归一化方程；不覆盖非紧收缩子或任意曲率流幂次。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。已检索全部可提取正文及补充工具名称，未发现作者披露 AI 使用。

analysis.priorityReason: 去除凸性假设的几何流闭收缩子分类。
